According to some reviews, it's a cheap piece of shit . . .

Looks like a great concept, but I can see a few gotchas in there...

  • The mechanism to spring/latch the outlet has to be fairly sturdy, because if it breaks you've got problems.

  • The electrical connection to the outlet also has to stand up to motion well; if it's via wires they're going to flex fairly often and may be subject to fatigue; if it's via contacts they have to be pretty well designed to stand up to repeated use and possible foreign matter.

Neither of the above is insurmountable but will add to the cost.

  • Also, a lot of modern cords have plug ends that fit flat to the wall; with this outlet they'll stick out even further. I don't think any will be obstructed from plugging in, but some may.

  • A few power bricks may not fit, hitting the wall.

  • (edit) It's also pretty darn deep, and won't fit in a lot of existing electrical boxes.
